status: prospective rationale; no fits or native jobs performed by this analysis

primary_sources.relevance: Native multioutput classifier, per-output class mapping, and probability interface.
Independent estimators per target differ from the shared-partition model proposed here; this wrapper must not be used.

motivation: Prior regression-based cap corroboration loses feasible cases when its scalar mean exceeds the cap. Direct nested feasibility targets test whether a different supervised objective improves decisions. This is a hypothesis, not evidence of improvement.
matched_comparison: Hold training membership, random seed, fixed explicit tree parameters, objective and decision policy constant between217and233 columns. This isolates the added16-column representation within this classifier. Comparison to regression also changes the objective, so it cannot isolate feature effects.
implementation_requirements: Use native shared-partition multioutput ExtraTreesClassifier, not three independently trained classifiers.
Explicitly freeze all model parameters including max_features, class_weight=None and no sample weights; do not silently inherit different classifier defaults.
Map probability of class1 through each output classes_ array, including singleton output classes.
Verify nested target probabilities are nondecreasing across32/64/128 from shared leaf membership and equal sample weighting. Do not merely sort or repair invalid outputs.
Fixed probability>=0.5 including exact ties is a preregistered experimental rule, not a calibrated risk or hardware-safety guarantee.
Keep area-error, tail-error, per-cap false-acceptance and false-rejection gates separate. A classifier accuracy score is insufficient.
interpretation_limits: Known class imbalance is disclosed; no class-weight, threshold, seed or hyperparameter search is authorized.
If no candidate passes retained development gates, record no selection; any frozen fresh diagnostic remains diagnostic and cannot justify promotion.
No CPU speedup, timing, power, universal safety or superiority over published ASIC PPA research is established by this experiment.
